description: "restore" copies one version's files into the draft (files added since are kept; users see nothing until neblla_promote "save"); to give the users a whole earlier release at once, use neblla_promote rollback. "migrate" copies the app with its whole history into the developer's own GitHub repo (needs Sign in with GitHub; both branches must be new there) and links the app to it. More: neblla_get_llms tools/versions

action.description: What to do. By action: restore {commit, branch?}; migrate {url, toBranch?, toProBranch?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

commit.description: restore: the version's sha, from neblla_versions_read "history".

toBranch.description: migrate: pre's branch in their repo (default "main").

toProBranch.description: migrate: pro's branch in their repo (default "neblla-pro").

name: neblla_versions
title: Restore or migrate versions
